title: TeamFlow Product Delivery Roadmap
description: A dependency-driven roadmap from product foundation through requirement governance, QA, release readiness and CTO pilot.

phases.title: Product and Architecture Foundation
phases.description: Complete product specifications, architecture decisions, repository guidance and AI-agent instructions.

phases.title: Engineering Foundation
phases.description: Create the monorepo, Angular application, Go API, PostgreSQL foundation, CI and local developer experience.

phases.title: Identity and Project Access
phases.description: Implement authentication, RBAC, users, projects, project membership and audit foundations.

phases.title: Requirement Governance
phases.description: Deliver requirement drafting, review, approval, immutable versions, comparison and audit history.

phases.title: Clarifications and Decisions
phases.description: Record questions, responses, confirmed decisions and blocking clarification rules.

phases.title: Change Request Governance
phases.description: Assess and approve post-approval changes with measurable impact and version traceability.

phases.title: Planning and Developer Workspace
phases.description: Provide epics, sprints, tasks, assignment, dependencies, blockers and developer traceability.

phases.title: QA and Defect Management
phases.description: Link test cases to requirement versions, execute tests and manage defects and retesting.

phases.title: Release Readiness
phases.description: Aggregate requirements, tasks, tests and defects into auditable release decisions.

phases.title: Dashboards and Reporting
phases.description: Provide project, team and management insights for stability, rework, quality and delivery risk.

phases.title: Security, Pilot and Deployment
phases.description: Harden security and performance, seed demo data, rehearse the CTO demonstration and run a pilot.

nodes.title: Product Documentation
nodes.description: Publish the complete product, workflow, API, security, testing and pitch documentation.

nodes.title: Roadmap Visualiser Specification
nodes.description: Define the content-driven interactive roadmap, node schema, layouts, filters and accessibility requirements.

nodes.title: Architecture Documentation
nodes.description: Define system context, containers, components, boundaries and runtime interactions.

nodes.title: System Context
nodes.description: Describe users, TeamFlow boundaries and external systems.

nodes.title: Container Architecture
nodes.description: Describe browser, web app, API, database, object storage and deployment boundaries.

nodes.title: Backend Component Architecture
nodes.description: Define modular-monolith modules, dependency rules and cross-cutting platform services.

nodes.title: Architecture Decision Records
nodes.description: Record the initial architecture decisions and their consequences.

nodes.title: Claude Code Instructions
nodes.description: Provide repository-wide implementation rules, commands, boundaries and definition of done.

nodes.title: Foundation Review
nodes.description: Review the foundation pack and approve the first implementation prompt.

nodes.title: Monorepo Bootstrap
nodes.description: Create apps/web, apps/api, packages, database, infrastructure, scripts and CI folders.

nodes.title: Angular Web Bootstrap
nodes.description: Create the standalone Angular application shell, routing, layout and environment configuration.

nodes.title: Go API Bootstrap
nodes.description: Create cmd/api, internal platform packages, configuration, structured logging and HTTP server.

nodes.title: PostgreSQL Foundation
nodes.description: Configure migrations, database access, transactions and local test database.

nodes.title: OpenAPI Foundation
nodes.description: Define API conventions, error envelope and generated client workflow.

nodes.title: CI Pipeline
nodes.description: Run formatting, linting, unit tests, integration tests and builds for every change.

nodes.title: Local Developer Environment
nodes.description: Provide Make targets and OCI-compatible dependencies for repeatable local development.

nodes.title: Authentication
nodes.description: Implement secure login, logout and session handling.

nodes.title: User Management
nodes.description: Create, activate and deactivate users.

nodes.title: Role and Permission Model
nodes.description: Implement global and project-scoped permissions.

nodes.title: Project Management
nodes.description: Create projects and project lifecycle operations.

nodes.title: Project Membership
nodes.description: Assign users and project roles.

nodes.title: Backend Authorization
nodes.description: Enforce permissions and project isolation on every endpoint.

nodes.title: Audit Foundation
nodes.description: Append immutable security and business audit events.

nodes.title: Requirement Draft
nodes.description: Create and edit structured requirement drafts.

nodes.title: Acceptance Criteria
nodes.description: Manage Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.
